summary: Iteration 322 - AI Classification History + Rollback Endpoints Testing. Backend: 20/20 tests PASSED (100%). All features verified: GET /ai-classification-history with days/limit params, POST /ai-classification-rollback with explicit target_type, empty body rollback using saved previous_type, no-op detection, bidirectional rollback, 404 handling, invalid type validation (400), RBAC (admin/manager 200, receptionist 403, no-auth 401), audit field updates (classified_by starts with 'manual-rollback:'), and fleet-classify-property-types now stores property_type_previous on LIVE updates.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/revenue/market-robot/ai-classification-history correctly returns {total, days, items[]} with all required fields
Each history item includes: property_id, name, city, country, current_type, previous_type, confidence, reason, classified_at, classified_by, rollback_available
rollback_available correctly computed as bool(previous_type and previous_type != current_type)
Rollback with empty body {} correctly uses saved property_type_previous
Returns 400 with valid types list when target_type is invalid (e.g. 'foo')
Returns 404 when property_id does not exist
No-op detection works: returns {ok:true, no_op:true} when target_type equals current_type
Bidirectional rollback works: calling rollback twice flips property_type back and forth
After rollback, classified_by is set to 'manual-rollback:<email>' format
fleet-classify-property-types now stores property_type_previous and property_type_previous_reason on LIVE updates (iter 322 enhancement)
RBAC correctly enforced: admin/manager get 200, receptionist gets 403, no-auth gets 401
seed_data_creation: Tests used existing city-gate property for rollback testing. Property type was flipped between hotel/guesthouse/aparthotel during tests.
